compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The oracle announces destruction of a sinful kingdom while refusing to destroy Jacob’s house utterly.
observations.label: The sinful kingdom and the spared house

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside the sinful kingdom and the spared house.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Amos 9:6–10 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the oracle announces destruction of a sinful kingdom while refusing to destroy Jacob’s house utterly. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The sinful kingdom and the spared house
